author: Redditenmo
body:
Tier 6: 

* General : Reaper
* Raids : Lindwyrm (Event, but if you get it, this will be your best raid pet till t10)

Tier 7:

 * General : Keep using reaper **or** swap to orichalum golem if you want it to defend you and you focus on your own offence.
 * Raids : Lindwyrm

Tier 8: 

 * Hordes : Big Cactus
 * Everything else: Phoenix (event, if you get this, it's better than Great Reaper at tier 9.)

Tier 9: 

 * General : Spawn of Anguish (always available, expensive) > Bashe (event) > Great Reaper (always available)
 * Hordes :  Big Cactus

Tier 10 : 
 
 * Get BeoA asap.
 * General : Chimera to tide you through until Replica Selene
 * Hordes : Fey Cactus to tide you through until Replica Selene
 * Raids : Fjalar to tide you through to -> Arisen Spiritgarm -> The Mightiest Mimic or Towerfall Titan if raid is immune to Arisen Spirit garm.

author: dreambig5
body:
For T6 Basilisk or Wyvern. Llamrai, Naggeneen, Scarecrow or Scary Skeleton for the event pets.

[https://orna.guide/pets?tier=6](https://orna.guide/pets?tier=6)

Honestly T6 is really quick to move out of. 

T7: Elysian Memories (life saver & boosts rewards from memory hunts). Twilight Wisp is a non-event pet but can be hard to find but it is a lifesaver! 

Ornalegends used to have a nice guide on their site but it seems to be down at the moment. Hit up discord or go through youtube video guides.
